notes.title: Patch 1.1.2 - Resonance
notes.content:
Long time, no see, Commander!

Today's patch has added a new upgrade to the Command Post that gives the Pioneer +1 percentage damage (damages target by 1% of its maximum life), making them a bit more viable against Tanks and Attila Walkers. The upgrade also gives them a fancier-looking laser!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584434/b218ca81057f92a633e828fabff5d488cf505f60.jpg[/img]
Bug fixes:
Fixed: DisableAbility trigger action had a duplicate that wasn't loaded with save games. This caused locked technologies to become unlocked after loading a saved game.
Fixed: map pathing undo strokes were not stored because of typo.

That's all for now. I know that the game's been neglected lately, but I hope I can keep updating it while working on Delilah, my next game. Thank you all for your patience!

Borington

notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 - Multiplayer with more than 2 players!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 
The week-long sale is over, but the work does not stop. I wanted to release this patch asap, but it will need a lot of testing. It would be nice if let's say an 8 player FFA was running smoothly, and in theory it should. In practice, well, join our Discord and we will organize a match over a virtual LAN. Anyways, here's the full feature list for 1.0.9:
- Reworked networking from the ground up to support more than 2 players (up to 8 at the moment)
- Added user name field to network skirmish panel. Default player name is your Steam ID.
- Recieving a chat message now plays sound effect
Fixed: Northern ramp was unwalkable on Orbit Royale map
Fixed: after loading a map, neutral units were yellow instead of white
Fixed: loading a skirmish map could load the wrong player as the human
Fixed: player 8 would automatically lose the game
Fixed: Announcer sounds no longer play while in menu;

This is all for today. This feature was my main goal for May, but now I can start working on something else. What medium-sized feature would you want in the game first and foremost? Things I've been thinking about are:
- Endless survival?
- More skirmish maps?
- More music tracks?
As always, I'll be looking forward to your feedback!

Borington

- Added user name field to network skirmish panel. Default player name is your Steam ID.
- Recieving a chat message now plays sound effect

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Difficulty modes and camera zoom
notes.content:
Commander!
Patch 1.0.5 for BlackChain is out! Here are the changes:
- EASY and HARD difficulty modes can now be selected for campaign maps. Difficulty can change unit placement, AI attacks , starting money, map triggers and objectives. It does not change individual unit strength, though I could add a Very Easy mode with 25% reduced enemy life...

- Added camera zoom with mouse scroll. This is what a zoomed out screen looks like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584434/c5f71697e11177ea7a01728ceeb7b8b860fb7d2f.jpg[/img]

- Added option to change starting money for skirmish maps
- Increased Firefly training time to 40 seconds (same as Attila MW)
- Added a wire to the first Gate Controller on the Tycor Mainframe mission
- Fixed: Fireflies can no longer attack Minervite Veins

Editor:
- RotX and RotY fields now have custom names if filed has a unique function
- Start location ID and control group option can now be accessed for AI Points
- Added melee map options to Map Properties panel. A skirmish map must have "isMelee" enabled
- Added Difficulty trigger condition
- Replaced unbildable terrain icon graphics

That's all for today. Take care!
Borington

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 - Supercores!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, here's this week's last update; might be the biggest one so far.
A new structure, the Blackchain Supercore has been added. It acts as 3 cores in 1 for the price of 200 minervite (you save at least 50 minervite, because you spare 2 Rover morphs). So where's the catch? It only has 500 hp, while 3 cores would have a total of 900. Also, its research costs 100/100. Don't forget, this is all subject to change.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39584434/49fbafcd43548b91781a05cdd6de2533dc5707e8.jpg[/img]

Other changes:
- Added stronger enemy turrets to campaign (Ultima Rail Turret)
- Fixed a bug that caused clients to disconnect from servers when using network tunneling
- Disabled abilities were not disabled on game loading.

Let me know if you encounter any issues, or have any feedback.
Borington
